text_block_list.text: One day, in front of the academy—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gramps—!
Over here, over here—!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Young Mistress Teio.
I see you have your friend with you as well...

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
I was quite astonished when you contacted me,
asking to bring over the "tea party" set
from the storehouse.

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
For the young mistress to host a tea party...
Whatever brought this about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Actually, the Prez asked us for a favor—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That concludes the outline for the fan interaction event,
'Royal Tea Party.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would appreciate everyone's cooperation
in providing a wonderful setting for socialization.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do my absolute best, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—And that's how it happened! So without further ado, Gramps,
hand over the tea party set, please♪
You brought the outdoor table too, right?

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text: ...Young Mistress, have you by chance forgotten?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
During the 'Grand Hide-and-Seek Tournament'
you hosted with the neighborhood children,
the table and chairs were unfortunately broken.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Was that so?

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... You have always been exceedingly lively,
and at times, rather mischievous...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nheheh! I'm gonna hide in here!
First, let's clear out whatever's on the shelf~...

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Young Mistress! That is a precious tea set—
Aaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this time I'll hide in the tree!
Let's use this as a stepping stool~...

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, hold on! Using the table as a foothold
to climb up is... Ghhk...!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
You possessed so much boundless energy
that this old man was constantly run ragged.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Truly a 'horse girl born running'...!
A certified ball of energy, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~... I don't do stuff like that anymore!
More importantly, having no tea party gear is a real problem.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I know!
If we don't have them, then why not just...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Make them ourselves!
Time for some DIY—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A table~, some chairs~,
and for the tablecloth, maybe a giant leaf would be cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, she really is mischievous...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! Hop!
Come on, Chiyono O, help me out!

At the academy plaza, I spotted Tokai Teio
and the others brimming with motivation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We even found tableware we can use,
so we somehow gathered all the necessary gear, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We're gonna make this tea party
a massive success—!!
